ev-start.intro.say: Evalation checks your code against the security and compliance standards you choose, and writes reports on what it finds.

ev-start.clock.say: This machine's clock is wrong, so Evalation refused it. Set the clock to the right time, then run /ev-start again.

ev-start.other.say: Evalation could not confirm this machine just now. Run /ev-start again in a few minutes. If it still fails, contact support@evalation.ai.

ev-start.unreachable.say: Evalation could not be reached. Check this machine is online, then run /ev-start again. If it still fails, contact support@evalation.ai.

ev-start.signing-in.say: Signing in sets up your Evalation account, or links this machine to it if you already have one.

ev-start.chosen.say: You are set up to check code against <titles>.

ev-start.no-packs.say: Run /ev-packs when you are ready to choose what to check against.

ev-start.run-here.say: Run /ev-run here to check this repository.

ev-start.run-elsewhere.say: Next, open Claude Code in the repository you want checked and run /ev-run.

ev-start.cost.say: It uses <count> pack credits, and you have <credits>.

ev-start.cost-one.say: It uses one pack credit, and you have <credits>.

ev-start.short.say: This selection uses <count> pack credits and you have <credits>, so a run would not start. To buy more pack credits, email support@evalation.ai, or choose fewer packs with /ev-packs.

ev-start.short-one.say: This selection uses one pack credit and you have none, so a run would not start. To buy pack credits, email support@evalation.ai.

ev-start.credits-unread.say: Your pack credits could not be read just now. Run /ev-account in a minute to see them.
